firstContext: ◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 3,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
You camp wild tonight — no pantry meal. Eat from your pack.
🍽️ Guizhen surveys the stacked shelves and nods. "The wild can rest. Splitting firewood instead — winter comes whether we like it or not."

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
